prompt:
I need you to set up our sprint planning assistant using the tools available in the workspace. Please read BRIEF.txt for the full context and action items.

Specifically:
1. Add the note described in the brief to the system.
2. Register the reminder mentioned in the brief. The reminder time is in the past (it should fire immediately when checked). Use exactly the channel ID and message text shown in the brief.
3. Run the due-check process to trigger any overdue reminders, then capture all the resulting notification messages into a file called `fired_notifications.txt` at the workspace root.

The workspace already has the necessary scripts. Check the skill documentation at SKILL.md to understand how everything works.
